full_prompt_en: The image is a square oil painting of a man and boy seated in a bright room beside a yellow sofa. The scene is viewed from a slightly raised angle, with a cluttered white coffee table filling the lower left and a long ochre-yellow sofa extending along the right. On the sofa, a gray-haired man in a white shirt and dark tie sits with crossed legs, leaning forward to look at something in his hands. A boy in a white shirt, light vest, and brown trousers sits on a chair nearer the center-left, turned toward him. Behind them, muted sea-green walls carry a framed landscape at the upper left, a small round wall ornament near the center, and a pale framed picture behind a tall white lamp. A white fireplace with a black opening occupies the left background; small pale objects and foliage sit along its mantel. On the right, a leafy plant grows behind the sofa, and a bright doorway opens into another pale space. The foreground table holds many loosely indicated cups, plates, papers, fruit, and small glasses, with broken yellow and blue marks scattered across a light cloth. Warm light enters from the right and front, catching the sofa, shirt sleeves, tablecloth, and doorway edge. The fireplace interior and lower furniture cast deep brown and charcoal shapes across the pale floor. The paint is laid in broad blocky strokes for walls and upholstery, then short quick dabs for the plant, faces, and table detail. Outlines remain incomplete, allowing adjacent color patches to build the forms. The composition is informal and domestic, balancing two quiet figures against lively sunlit surfaces and the busy horizontal spread of the table.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形油画：一名男子和男孩坐在明亮房间的黄沙发旁。视点略高，杂乱的白色茶几填满左下方，一张长赭黄色沙发沿右侧伸展。沙发上，一位灰发男子穿白衬衫、系深领带，交叠双腿坐着，向前俯看手中的东西。男孩穿白衬衫、浅马甲与棕裤，坐在中央偏左的椅上，转向他。两人身后，低饱和海绿色墙面左上挂一幅风景框画，中央附近有小圆形墙饰，白色高台灯后有一幅浅色框画。白壁炉与黑炉口占据左侧背景；炉台上放着浅色小物与叶丛。右侧一棵多叶植物在沙发后生长，明亮门洞通向另一处浅色空间。前景桌上松散描着许多杯、盘、纸、果物和小玻璃杯，浅桌布上散满碎黄与蓝色笔痕。暖光从右侧和前方进入，落在沙发、衬衣袖、桌布和门框上。壁炉内部与家具下部在浅地面上压出深棕与炭黑形状。墙和软垫由宽而方的笔触铺色，植物、面孔与桌上细节则用短促点笔。轮廓不完整，相邻色片彼此拼合成形。构图随意而居家，让两位安静人物与活跃的受光表面、桌面繁忙的横向展开相平衡。
style_prompt_en: Oil paint uses broad broken planes and quick small dabs to hold a sunlit composition together. Muted sea-green and warm ochre form the largest fields, interrupted by cream white highlights, leafy dark greens, and deep brown recesses. Edges remain partly open; adjacent patches of color define volume without firm enclosing lines. Light arrives from one side, brightening high planes and leaving large angular shadows beneath and between them. Horizontal spreads of small colored marks animate a calm blocky structure. Brush texture is visible, with thinner scumbled passages beside opaque warm accents. The overall effect is airy, lived-in, and painterly, balancing broad color area with brisk detail.
style_prompt_zh: 油彩用宽而破碎的色面与迅速的小点笔把受日光照亮的构图连在一起。低饱和海绿与暖赭组成最大色场，其间被奶油白亮面、叶绿暗色和深棕凹处打断。边缘部分敞开，相邻色片不靠坚硬封闭线也能界定体积。光从一侧进入，照亮较高的平面，在其下和之间留下大块棱角阴影。横向铺开的彩色小记号让安静的方块结构活跃起来。笔触肌理可见，较薄擦染段落挨着厚实暖色点。整体通透、带生活痕迹且有绘画性，在宽阔色彩面积与轻快细节间保持平衡。
theme_en: A man and boy seated in a bright room beside a yellow sofa
theme_zh: 一名男子和男孩坐在明亮房间的黄沙发旁
name: Fairfield Porter
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
